openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: 清泉跨境系统 API
  version: 0.1.0
  description: |
    Phase 0 接口草案。鉴权：用户 JWT（Bearer）或采集 API Key（X-Api-Key）。
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:8000
    description: local
tags:
  - name: health
  - name: auth
  - name: shops
  - name: ingest
  - name: tasks
  - name: export
  - name: collectors

paths:
  /health:
    get:
      tags: [health]
      summary: 健康检查
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status: { type: string, example: ok }
                  time: { type: string, format: date-time }

  /api/v1/auth/login:
    post:
      tags: [auth]
      summary: 登录
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [username, password]
              properties:
                username: { type: string }
                password: { type: string, format: password }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: JWT
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  access_token: { type: string }
                  token_type: { type: string, example: bearer }
                  expires_in: { type: integer }
        "401":
          description: 用户名或密码错误

  /api/v1/auth/me:
    get:
      tags: [auth]
      summary: 当前用户
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: 用户资料
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/User"

  /api/v1/shops:
    get:
      tags: [shops]
      summary: 店铺列表
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - in: query
          name: platform
          schema: { type: string, enum: [amazon, tiktok, temu, other] }
        - in: query
          name: status
          schema: { type: string, enum: [active, disabled] }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  items:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Shop" }
    post:
      tags: [shops]
      summary: 创建店铺
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ShopCreate" }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Shop" }

  /api/v1/shops/{shopId}:
    patch:
      tags: [shops]
      summary: 更新店铺
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/shopId"
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/ShopUpdate" }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Shop" }

  /api/v1/ingest/{source}:
    post:
      tags: [ingest]
      summary: 采集上报（单条或批量）
      security: [{ apiKeyAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - in: path
          name: source
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - tiktok_ads
              - temu_browser
              - temu_openapi
              - sellfox_sales
              - sellfox_performance
              - sellfox_product_temu
              - sellfox_sales_days
              - amazon_front
              - wms_inventory
              - hwc_bridge_event
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              oneOf:
                - $ref: "#/components/schemas/IngestEnvelope"
                - $ref: "#/components/schemas/IngestBatch"
            examples:
              single:
                summary: 单条 TK 广告
                value:
                  platform: tiktok
                  shop_id: "27501502216807"
                  shop_name: Deal to deal
                  biz_date: "2026-07-26"
                  collected_at: "2026-07-27T17:25:01+08:00"
                  idempotency_key: "tiktok_ads:27501502216807:拖把7/13:2026-07-26"
                  payload:
                    campaign_name: "拖把7/13"
                    spend: 187.79
                    orders: 121
                    roi: 9.9
                    revenue: 1872.64
                    row_status: success
              batch:
                summary: 批量
                value:
                  items:
                    - platform: tiktok
                      shop_id: "27501502216807"
                      shop_name: Deal to deal
                      biz_date: "2026-07-26"
                      collected_at: "2026-07-27T17:25:01+08:00"
                      idempotency_key: "tiktok_ads:27501502216807:拖把7/13:2026-07-26"
                      payload:
                        campaign_name: "拖把7/13"
                        spend: 187.79
                        orders: 121
                        roi: 9.9
                        revenue: 1872.64
      responses:
        "200":
          description: 接受（含幂等命中）
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/IngestResult" }
        "401":
          description: API Key 无效
        "422":
          description: 校验失败

  /api/v1/tasks:
    get:
      tags: [tasks]
      summary: 任务列表
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - in: query
          name: status
          schema: { type: string, enum: [open, in_progress, resolved, cancelled] }
        - in: query
          name: platform
          schema: { type: string }
        - in: query
          name: shop_id
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
        - in: query
          name: owner_user_id
          schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
        - in: query
          name: page
          schema: { type: integer, default: 1 }
        - in: query
          name: page_size
          schema: { type: integer, default: 20 }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  total: { type: integer }
                  items:
                    type: array
                    items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Task" }
    post:
      tags: [tasks]
      summary: 手动创建任务
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/TaskCreate" }
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Task" }

  /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}/progress:
    post:
      tags: [tasks]
      summary: 更新进度（进行中任务）
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/taskId"
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [note]
              properties:
                note: { type: string }
                status:
                  type: string
                  enum: [open, in_progress]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Task" }

  /api/v1/tasks/{taskId}/resolve:
    post:
      tags: [tasks]
      summary: 闭环任务
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/taskId"
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                note: { type: string }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/Task" }

  /api/v1/export/feishu:
    post:
      tags: [export]
      summary: 触发飞书同步
      security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                table_key:
                  type: string
                  description: 逻辑表，如 tasks / tk_ads_daily
                  example: tasks
                mode:
                  type: string
                  enum: [incremental, rebuild]
                  default: incremental
                biz_date:
                  type: string
                  format: date
      responses:
        "202":
          description: 已入队
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  job_id: { type: string, format: uuid }

  /api/v1/collectors/heartbeat:
    post:
      tags: [collectors]
      summary: 边缘节点心跳
      security: [{ apiKeyAuth: [] }]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [node_id]
              properties:
                node_id: { type: string }
                version: { type: string }
                meta: { type: object, additionalProperties: true }
      responses:
        "200":
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  server_time: { type: string, format: date-time }
                  config_version: { type: string }

components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
    apiKeyAuth:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: X-Api-Key

  parameters:
    shopId:
      in: path
      name: shopId
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, format: uuid }
    taskId:
      in: path
      name: taskId
      required: true
      schema: { type: string, format: uuid }

  schemas:
    User:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        username: { type: string }
        display_name: { type: string }
        is_admin: { type: boolean }

    Shop:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        platform: { type: string }
        external_shop_id: { type: string }
        name: { type: string }
        primary_owner_user_id: { type: string, format: uuid, nullable: true }
        timezone: { type: string }
        currency: { type: string }
        status: { type: string }
        meta: { type: object, additionalProperties: true }

    ShopCreate:
      type: object
      required: [platform, external_shop_id, name]
      properties:
        platform: { type: string }
        external_shop_id: { type: string }
        name: { type: string }
        primary_owner_user_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        timezone: { type: string, default: Asia/Shanghai }
        currency: { type: string, default: GBP }
        meta: { type: object }

    ShopUpdate:
      type: object
      properties:
        name: { type: string }
        primary_owner_user_id: { type: string, format: uuid, nullable: true }
        status: { type: string }
        meta: { type: object }

    IngestEnvelope:
      type: object
      required: [idempotency_key, payload]
      properties:
        platform: { type: string }
        shop_id:
          type: string
          description: 外部店铺 ID（赛狐/紫鸟等）
        shop_name: { type: string }
        biz_date: { type: string, format: date }
        collected_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        idempotency_key: { type: string, maxLength: 256 }
        payload: { type: object, additionalProperties: true }
        evidence:
          type: object
          properties:
            screenshot_url: { type: string, nullable: true }
            source_url: { type: string, nullable: true }
            raw_ref: { type: string, nullable: true }

    IngestBatch:
      type: object
      required: [items]
      properties:
        items:
          type: array
          minItems: 1
          maxItems: 500
          items: { $ref: "#/components/schemas/IngestEnvelope" }

    IngestResult:
      type: object
      properties:
        accepted: { type: integer }
        duplicated: { type: integer }
        failed: { type: integer }
        results:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              idempotency_key: { type: string }
              id: { type: string, format: uuid }
              status: { type: string, enum: [created, duplicated, failed] }
              error: { type: string, nullable: true }

    Task:
      type: object
      properties:
        id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        dedupe_key: { type: string }
        status: { type: string, enum: [open, in_progress, resolved, cancelled] }
        platform: { type: string }
        shop_id: { type: string, format: uuid, nullable: true }
        anomaly_type: { type: string }
        biz_id: { type: string }
        title: { type: string }
        owner_user_id: { type: string, format: uuid, nullable: true }
        due_at: { type: string, format: date-time, nullable: true }
        progress_note: { type: string, nullable: true }
        created_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        updated_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        resolved_at: { type: string, format: date-time, nullable: true }

    TaskCreate:
      type: object
      required: [platform, anomaly_type, biz_id, title]
      properties:
        platform: { type: string }
        shop_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        anomaly_type: { type: string }
        biz_id: { type: string }
        title: { type: string }
        owner_user_id: { type: string, format: uuid }
        due_at: { type: string, format: date-time }
        progress_note: { type: string }

-- 清泉跨境系统 · 初始表结构 Phase 0
-- PostgreSQL 16+
-- 执行: psql $DATABASE_URL -f 001_init.sql

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pgcrypto";

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 组织与用户
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS org_user (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    username        TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash   TEXT NOT NULL,
    display_name    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    is_admin        BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    is_active       BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS org_dept (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    name            TEXT NOT NULL,
    parent_id       UUID REFERENCES org_dept(id),
    sort_order      INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 店铺
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shop (
    id                      UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    platform                TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (platform IN ('amazon', 'tiktok', 'temu', 'other')),
    external_shop_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    name                    TEXT NOT NULL,
    alias_names             JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
    primary_owner_user_id   UUID REFERENCES org_user(id),
    timezone                TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Shanghai',
    currency                TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GBP',
    status                  TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled')),
    meta                    JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at              TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at              TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (platform, external_shop_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shop_platform ON shop(platform);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shop_status ON shop(status);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 采集原始与幂等
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ingest_raw (
    id                  UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    source              TEXT NOT NULL,
    platform            TEXT,
    shop_external_id    TEXT,
    shop_id             UUID REFERENCES shop(id),
    biz_date            DATE,
    idempotency_key     TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload             JSONB NOT NULL,
    evidence            JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    collected_at        TIMESTAMPTZ,
    received_at         TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    process_status      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'accepted'
                        CHECK (process_status IN ('accepted', 'processed', 'failed')),
    error_message       TEXT
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_ingest_idempotency
    ON ingest_raw (idempotency_key);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ingest_source_date
    ON ingest_raw (source, biz_date DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ingest_received
    ON ingest_raw (received_at DESC);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TK 广告事实（Phase0 优先接通）
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_ads_campaign_daily (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    shop_id         UUID REFERENCES shop(id),
    shop_external_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    shop_name       TEXT,
    biz_date        DATE NOT NULL,
    campaign_name   TEXT NOT NULL,
    spend           NUMERIC(18, 4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    orders          NUMERIC(18, 4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    roi             NUMERIC(18, 6),
    revenue         NUMERIC(18, 4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    currency        TEXT DEFAULT 'GBP',
    row_status      TEXT DEFAULT 'success',
    source_url      TEXT,
    collected_at    TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ingest_id       UUID REFERENCES ingest_raw(id),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (shop_external_id, campaign_name, biz_date)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ads_biz_date ON fact_ads_campaign_daily (biz_date DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ads_shop_date ON fact_ads_campaign_daily (shop_id, biz_date DESC);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 异常与任务
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS anomaly_event (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    platform        TEXT NOT NULL,
    shop_id         UUID REFERENCES shop(id),
    anomaly_type    TEXT NOT NULL,
    biz_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
    biz_id_type     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
    dedupe_key      TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'warn'
                    CHECK (severity IN ('info', 'warn', 'high', 'critical')),
    title           TEXT NOT NULL,
    detail          TEXT,
    payload         JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    detected_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    resolved_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,
    task_id         UUID,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anomaly_dedupe ON anomaly_event (dedupe_key, detected_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anomaly_detected ON anomaly_event (detected_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task (
    id                  UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    dedupe_key          TEXT NOT NULL,
    status              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'
                        CHECK (status IN ('open', 'in_progress', 'resolved', 'cancelled')),
    platform            TEXT NOT NULL,
    shop_id             UUID REFERENCES shop(id),
    anomaly_type        TEXT NOT NULL,
    biz_id              TEXT NOT NULL,
    title               TEXT NOT NULL,
    owner_user_id       UUID REFERENCES org_user(id),
    due_at              TIMESTAMPTZ,
    progress_note       TEXT,
    source_event_id     UUID REFERENCES anomaly_event(id),
    created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    resolved_at         TIMESTAMPTZ
);

-- 会议规则：未闭环任务按 dedupe_key 唯一
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_task_open_dedupe
    ON task (dedupe_key)
    WHERE status IN ('open', 'in_progress');

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_status ON task (status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_owner ON task (owner_user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_shop ON task (shop_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_due ON task (due_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_progress (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    task_id         UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES task(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    note            TEXT NOT NULL,
    from_status     TEXT,
    to_status       TEXT,
    operator_user_id UUID REFERENCES org_user(id),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_progress_task ON task_progress (task_id, created_at DESC);

-- 回填 anomaly.task_id FK（表创建顺序）
ALTER TABLE anomaly_event
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_anomaly_task;
ALTER TABLE anomaly_event
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_anomaly_task
    FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES task(id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 飞书同步
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_feishu_map (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    table_key       TEXT NOT NULL,
    local_table     TEXT NOT NULL,
    local_id        UUID NOT NULL,
    app_token       TEXT NOT NULL,
    table_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_hash    TEXT,
    synced_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (table_key, local_id),
    UNIQUE (app_token, table_id, record_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_feishu_job (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    table_key       TEXT NOT NULL,
    mode            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'incremental'
                    CHECK (mode IN ('incremental', 'rebuild')),
    status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'running', 'success', 'failed')),
    payload         JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    error_message   TEXT,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    started_at      TIMESTAMPTZ,
    finished_at     TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbox_event (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    event_type      TEXT NOT NULL,
    aggregate_type  TEXT NOT NULL,
    aggregate_id    UUID NOT NULL,
    payload         JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'done', 'failed')),
    attempts        INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    available_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    processed_at    TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outbox_pending
    ON outbox_event (status, available_at)
    WHERE status IN ('pending', 'failed');

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 采集节点心跳
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS collector_node (
    node_id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    version         TEXT,
    meta            JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    last_seen_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 审计
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    actor_user_id   UUID REFERENCES org_user(id),
    action          TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource_type   TEXT,
    resource_id     TEXT,
    detail          JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_created ON audit_log (created_at DESC);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 种子数据（密码: admin123 — 首次登录后务必修改）
-- hash = bcrypt of "admin123" cost 12
-- 由应用启动 seed 写入更稳妥；此处仅结构占位注释
-- INSERT INTO org_user (username, password_hash, display_name, is_admin)
-- VALUES ('admin', '<bcrypt>', '管理员', TRUE);

COMMENT ON TABLE task IS '跟踪任务：未闭环唯一 dedupe_key = platform:biz_id:anomaly_type';
COMMENT ON TABLE ingest_raw IS '采集上报原始；idempotency_key 全局唯一';
COMMENT ON TABLE fact_ads_campaign_daily IS 'TK 广告系列日指标；Phase0 优先';
COMMENT ON TABLE sync_feishu_map IS '本地记录与飞书 record_id 映射，支持 update';

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_ingest_idempotency
    ON ingest_raw (idempotency_key);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ingest_source_date
    ON ingest_raw (source, biz_date DESC);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ingest_received
    ON ingest_raw (received_at DESC);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TK 广告事实（Phase0 优先接通）
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fact_ads_campaign_daily (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    shop_id         UUID REFERENCES shop(id),
    shop_external_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    shop_name       TEXT,
    biz_date        DATE NOT NULL,
    campaign_name   TEXT NOT NULL,
    spend           NUMERIC(18, 4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    orders          NUMERIC(18, 4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    roi             NUMERIC(18, 6),
    revenue         NUMERIC(18, 4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    currency        TEXT DEFAULT 'GBP',
    row_status      TEXT DEFAULT 'success',
    source_url      TEXT,
    collected_at    TIMESTAMPTZ,
    ingest_id       UUID REFERENCES ingest_raw(id),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (shop_external_id, campaign_name, biz_date)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ads_biz_date ON fact_ads_campaign_daily (biz_date DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ads_shop_date ON fact_ads_campaign_daily (shop_id, biz_date DESC);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 异常与任务
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS anomaly_event (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    platform        TEXT NOT NULL,
    shop_id         UUID REFERENCES shop(id),
    anomaly_type    TEXT NOT NULL,
    biz_id          TEXT NOT NULL,
    biz_id_type     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
    dedupe_key      TEXT NOT NULL,
    severity        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'warn'
                    CHECK (severity IN ('info', 'warn', 'high', 'critical')),
    title           TEXT NOT NULL,
    detail          TEXT,
    payload         JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    detected_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    resolved_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,
    task_id         UUID,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anomaly_dedupe ON anomaly_event (dedupe_key, detected_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_anomaly_detected ON anomaly_event (detected_at DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task (
    id                  UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    dedupe_key          TEXT NOT NULL,
    status              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'
                        CHECK (status IN ('open', 'in_progress', 'resolved', 'cancelled')),
    platform            TEXT NOT NULL,
    shop_id             UUID REFERENCES shop(id),
    anomaly_type        TEXT NOT NULL,
    biz_id              TEXT NOT NULL,
    title               TEXT NOT NULL,
    owner_user_id       UUID REFERENCES org_user(id),
    due_at              TIMESTAMPTZ,
    progress_note       TEXT,
    source_event_id     UUID REFERENCES anomaly_event(id),
    created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    resolved_at         TIMESTAMPTZ
);

-- 会议规则：未闭环任务按 dedupe_key 唯一
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_task_open_dedupe
    ON task (dedupe_key)
    WHERE status IN ('open', 'in_progress');

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_status ON task (status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_owner ON task (owner_user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_shop ON task (shop_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_due ON task (due_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS task_progress (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    task_id         UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES task(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    note            TEXT NOT NULL,
    from_status     TEXT,
    to_status       TEXT,
    operator_user_id UUID REFERENCES org_user(id),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_task_progress_task ON task_progress (task_id, created_at DESC);

-- 回填 anomaly.task_id FK（表创建顺序）
ALTER TABLE anomaly_event
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS fk_anomaly_task;
ALTER TABLE anomaly_event
    ADD CONSTRAINT fk_anomaly_task
    FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES task(id);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 飞书同步
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_feishu_map (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    table_key       TEXT NOT NULL,
    local_table     TEXT NOT NULL,
    local_id        UUID NOT NULL,
    app_token       TEXT NOT NULL,
    table_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
    record_id       TEXT NOT NULL,
    content_hash    TEXT,
    synced_at       TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (table_key, local_id),
    UNIQUE (app_token, table_id, record_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sync_feishu_job (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    table_key       TEXT NOT NULL,
    mode            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'incremental'
                    CHECK (mode IN ('incremental', 'rebuild')),
    status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'running', 'success', 'failed')),
    payload         JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    error_message   TEXT,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    started_at      TIMESTAMPTZ,
    finished_at     TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbox_event (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    event_type      TEXT NOT NULL,
    aggregate_type  TEXT NOT NULL,
    aggregate_id    UUID NOT NULL,
    payload         JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                    CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'done', 'failed')),
    attempts        INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    available_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    processed_at    TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outbox_pending
    ON outbox_event (status, available_at)
    WHERE status IN ('pending', 'failed');

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 采集节点心跳
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS collector_node (
    node_id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    version         TEXT,
    meta            JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    last_seen_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 审计
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_log (
    id              UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    actor_user_id   UUID REFERENCES org_user(id),
    action          TEXT NOT NULL,
    resource_type   TEXT,
    resource_id     TEXT,
    detail          JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_created ON audit_log (created_at DESC);

name: qingquan

services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: ${POSTGRES_USER:-qingquan}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-qingquan}
      POSTGRES_DB: ${POSTGRES_DB:-qingquan}
      TZ: Asia/Shanghai
    ports:
      - "${POSTGRES_PORT:-5432}:5432"
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - ../backend/migrations/001_init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/001_init.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $$POSTGRES_USER -d $$POSTGRES_DB"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    ports:
      - "${REDIS_PORT:-6379}:6379"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 10

  api:
    build:
      context: ../backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    env_file:
      - ../.env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-qingquan}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-qingquan}@db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-qingquan}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      APP_ENV: ${APP_ENV:-dev}
      TZ: Asia/Shanghai
    ports:
      - "${API_PORT:-8000}:8000"
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    command: >
      uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
    volumes:
      - ../backend/app:/app/app
      - ../backend/migrations:/app/migrations

  worker:
    build:
      context: ../backend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    env_file:
      - ../.env
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgresql+asyncpg://${POSTGRES_USER:-qingquan}:${POSTGRES_PASSWORD:-qingquan}@db:5432/${POSTGRES_DB:-qingquan}
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379/0
      APP_ENV: ${APP_ENV:-dev}
      TZ: Asia/Shanghai
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
    command: python -m app.jobs.worker
    volumes:
      - ../backend/app:/app/app
    profiles:
      - worker

volumes:
  pgdata:

"""任务引擎：去重键 + 进行中唯一 + 闭环后重建。"""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.config import get_settings


def build_dedupe_key(platform: str, biz_id: str, anomaly_type: str) -> str:
    return f"{platform}:{biz_id}:{anomaly_type}"


async def enqueue_feishu_sync(db: AsyncSession, task_id: str) -> None:
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO outbox_event (id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload)
            VALUES (:id, 'feishu.sync', 'task', :task_id, CAST(:payload AS jsonb))
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "task_id": task_id,
            "payload": f'{{"table_key":"tasks","local_id":"{task_id}"}}',
        },
    )


async def upsert_task_from_anomaly(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    platform: str,
    shop_id: str | None,
    anomaly_type: str,
    biz_id: str,
    title: str,
    detail: str | None = None,
    payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    owner_user_id: str | None = None,
    severity: str = "warn",
    biz_id_type: str = "unknown",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """存在未闭环同键任务则更新进度；否则新建。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    dedupe = build_dedupe_key(platform, biz_id, anomaly_type)
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

from typing import Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.infra.db import get_db
from app.infra.security import get_current_user

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/shops", tags=["shops"])


class ShopCreate(BaseModel):
    platform: str
    external_shop_id: str
    name: str
    primary_owner_user_id: str | None = None
    timezone: str = "Asia/Shanghai"
    currency: str = "GBP"
    meta: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ShopUpdate(BaseModel):
    name: str | None = None
    primary_owner_user_id: str | None = None
    status: str | None = None
    meta: dict[str, Any] | None = None


@router.get("")
async def list_shops(
    platform: str | None = None,
    status: str | None = Query(default="active"),
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    clauses = ["1=1"]
    params: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if platform:
        clauses.append("platform = :platform")
        params["platform"] = platform
    if status:
        clauses.append("status = :status")
        params["status"] = status
    sql = f"""
        SELECT id::text, platform, external_shop_id, name, primary_owner_user_id::text,
               timezone, currency, status, meta
        FROM shop
        WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}
        ORDER BY platform, name
    """
    rows = (await db.execute(text(sql), params)).mappings().all()
    return {"items": [dict(r) for r in rows]}

async def create_shop(
    body: ShopCreate,

    _: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from datetime import date, datetime
from typing import Any
from uuid import uuid4

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlalchemy import text
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.infra.db import get_db
from app.infra.security import require_ingest_key

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/ingest", tags=["ingest"])


class Evidence(BaseModel):
    screenshot_url: str | None = None
    source_url: str | None = None
    raw_ref: str | None = None


class IngestEnvelope(BaseModel):
    platform: str | None = None
    shop_id: str | None = Field(default=None, description="外部店铺 ID")
    shop_name: str | None = None
    biz_date: date | None = None
    collected_at: datetime | None = None
    idempotency_key: str
    payload: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    evidence: Evidence | None = None


class IngestBatch(BaseModel):
    items: list[IngestEnvelope] = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)


async def _resolve_shop_uuid(db: AsyncSession, platform: str | None, external_id: str | None) -> str | None:
    if not external_id:
        return None
    if platform:
        row = (
            await db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                    SELECT id::text FROM shop
                    WHERE external_shop_id = :eid AND platform = :platform
                    LIMIT 1
                    """
                ),
                {"eid": external_id, "platform": platform},
            )
        ).first()
        if row:
            return row[0]
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            text("SELECT id::text FROM shop WHERE external_shop_id = :eid LIMIT 1"),
            {"eid": external_id},
        )
    ).first()
    return row[0] if row else None


async def _process_tiktok_ads(
    db: AsyncSession,
    *,
    ingest_id: str,
    env: IngestEnvelope,
    shop_uuid: str | None,
) -> None:
    p = env.payload
    campaign = str(p.get("campaign_name") or p.get("campaign") or "").strip()
    if not campaign or not env.biz_date or not env.shop_id:
        raise ValueError("tiktok_ads 需要 shop_id, biz_date, payload.campaign_name")

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO fact_ads_campaign_daily (
                id, shop_id, shop_external_id, shop_name, biz_date, campaign_name,
                spend, orders, roi, revenue, currency, row_status, source_url,
                collected_at, ingest_id, created_at, updated_at
            ) VALUES (
                :id, :shop_id, :shop_external_id, :shop_name, :biz_date, :campaign_name,
                :spend, :orders, :roi, :revenue, :currency, :row_status, :source_url,
                :collected_at, :ingest_id, now(), now()
            )
            ON CONFLICT (shop_external_id, campaign_name, biz_date) DO UPDATE SET
                spend = EXCLUDED.spend,
                orders = EXCLUDED.orders,
                roi = EXCLUDED.roi,
                revenue = EXCLUDED.revenue,
                currency = EXCLUDED.currency,
                row_status = EXCLUDED.row_status,
                source_url = EXCLUDED.source_url,
                collected_at = EXCLUDED.collected_at,
                ingest_id = EXCLUDED.ingest_id,
                shop_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.shop_id, fact_ads_campaign_daily.shop_id),
                shop_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.shop_name, fact_ads_campaign_daily.shop_name),
                updated_at = now()
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "shop_id": shop_uuid,
            "shop_external_id": env.shop_id,
            "shop_name": env.shop_name,
            "biz_date": env.biz_date,
            "campaign_name": campaign,
            "spend": float(p.get("spend") or 0),
            "orders": float(p.get("orders") or 0),
            "roi": float(p["roi"]) if p.get("roi") is not None else None,
            "revenue": float(p.get("revenue") or 0),
            "currency": p.get("currency") or "GBP",
            "row_status": p.get("row_status") or "success",
            "source_url": (env.evidence.source_url if env.evidence else None) or p.get("source_url"),
            "collected_at": env.collected_at,
            "ingest_id": ingest_id,
        },
    )


async def _ingest_one(
    db: AsyncSession,
    source: str,
    env: IngestEnvelope,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    platform = env.platform or ("tiktok" if source.startswith("tiktok") else None)
    shop_uuid = await _resolve_shop_uuid(db, platform, env.shop_id)
    ingest_id = str(uuid4())
    evidence = (env.evidence.model_dump() if env.evidence else {}) or {}

    try:
        await db.execute(
            text(
                """
                INSERT INTO ingest_raw (
                    id, source, platform, shop_external_id, shop_id, biz_date,
                    idempotency_key, payload, evidence, collected_at, process_status
                ) VALUES (
                    :id, :source, :platform, :shop_external_id, :shop_id, :biz_date,
                    :idempotency_key, CAST(:payload AS jsonb), CAST(:evidence AS jsonb),
                    :collected_at, 'accepted'
                )
                """
            ),
            {
                "id": ingest_id,
                "source": source,
                "platform": platform,
                "shop_external_id": env.shop_id,
                "shop_id": shop_uuid,
                "biz_date": env.biz_date,
                "idempotency_key": env.idempotency_key,
                "payload": json.dumps(env.payload, ensure_ascii=False, default=str),
                "evidence": json.dumps(evidence, ensure_ascii=False),
                "collected_at": env.collected_at,
            },
        )
    except IntegrityError:
        await db.rollback()
        existing = (
            await db.execute(
                text("SELECT id::text FROM ingest_raw WHERE idempotency_key = :k"),
                {"k": env.idempotency_key},
            )
        ).first()
        return {
            "idempotency_key": env.idempotency_key,
            "id": existing[0] if existing else None,
            "status": "duplicated",
            "error": None,
        }

    try:
        if source == "tiktok_ads":
            await _process_tiktok_ads(db, ingest_id=ingest_id, env=env, shop_uuid=shop_uuid)
        # 其它 source Phase1+ 再挂处理器；原始仍保留
        await db.execute(
            text("UPDATE ingest_raw SET process_status = 'processed' WHERE id = :id"),
            {"id": ingest_id},
        )
        await db.commit()
        return {
            "idempotency_key": env.idempotency_key,
            "id": ingest_id,
            "status": "created",
            "error": None,
        }
    except Exception as exc:
        await db.rollback()
        # 重新标记失败：原事务已回滚，补写失败状态可能丢 id，简化返回 failed
        return {
            "idempotency_key": env.idempotency_key,
            "id": ingest_id,
            "status": "failed",
            "error": str(exc),
        }


@router.post("/{source}")
async def ingest(
    source: str,
    body: dict[str, Any],
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(require_ingest_key),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if "items" in body:
        batch = IngestBatch.model_validate(body)
        items = batch.items
    else:
        items = [IngestEnvelope.model_validate(body)]

    results = []
    for env in items:
        results.append(await _ingest_one(db, source, env))

    return {
        "accepted": sum(1 for r in results if r["status"] == "created"),
        "duplicated": sum(1 for r in results if r["status"] == "duplicated"),
        "failed": sum(1 for r in results if r["status"] == "failed"),
        "results": results,
    }

async def export_feishu(
    body: ExportBody,
    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: dict = Depends(get_current_user),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    import json
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    job_id = str(uuid4())
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO sync_feishu_job (id, table_key, mode, status, payload)
            VALUES (:id, :table_key, :mode, 'pending', CAST(:payload AS jsonb))
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": job_id,
            "table_key": body.table_key,
            "mode": body.mode,
            "payload": json.dumps({"biz_date": body.biz_date}, ensure_ascii=False),
        },
    )
    await db.execute(
        text(
            """
            INSERT INTO outbox_event (id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload)
            VALUES (:id, 'feishu.job', 'sync_feishu_job', :job_id, CAST(:payload AS jsonb))
            """
        ),
        {
            "id": str(uuid4()),
            "job_id": job_id,
            "payload": json.dumps({"table_key": body.table_key, "mode": body.mode}),
        },
    )
    await db.commit()

    db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db),
    _: str = Depends(require_ingest_key),
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    import json
    from datetime import datetime, timezone

    await db.execute(
        text(
            """

        },
    )
    await db.commit()
    return {
        "server_time": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "config_version": "phase0",
    }

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import logging
from typing import Any

import httpx

from app.config import get_settings

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

BASE = "https://open.feishu.cn/open-apis"


class FeishuError(RuntimeError):
    pass


async def get_tenant_access_token() -> str | None:
    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.feishu_app_id or not settings.feishu_app_secret:
        return None
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=30) as client:
        resp = await client.post(
            f"{BASE}/auth/v3/tenant_access_token/internal",
            json={"app_id": settings.feishu_app_id, "app_secret": settings.feishu_app_secret},
        )
        data = resp.json()
        if data.get("code") != 0:
            raise FeishuError(f"token failed: {data}")
        return data["tenant_access_token"]


def content_hash(fields: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    raw = json.dumps(fields, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, default=str)
    return hashlib.sha256(raw.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


async def batch_create_records(
    token: str,
    app_token: str,
    table_id: str,
    records: list[dict[str, Any]],
) -> list[str]:
    """返回 record_id 列表。"""
    if not records:
        return []
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60) as client:
        resp = await client.post(
            f"{BASE}/bitable/v1/apps/{app_token}/tables/{table_id}/records/batch_create",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
            json={"records": [{"fields": r} for r in records]},
        )
        data = resp.json()
        if data.get("code") != 0:
            raise FeishuError(f"batch_create failed: {data}")
        return [item["record_id"] for item in data.get("data", {}).get("records", [])]


async def batch_update_records(
    token: str,
    app_token: str,
    table_id: str,
    items: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]],
) -> None:
    if not items:
        return
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60) as client:
        resp = await client.post(
            f"{BASE}/bitable/v1/apps/{app_token}/tables/{table_id}/records/batch_update",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
            json={
                "records": [
                    {"record_id": rid, "fields": fields} for rid, fields in items
                ]
            },
        )
        data = resp.json()
        if data.get("code") != 0:
            raise FeishuError(f"batch_update failed: {data}")


def task_to_fields(task: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """映射到飞书列名（需与多维表一致，可按环境改别名）。"""
    return {
        "平台": task.get("platform") or "",
        "业务ID": task.get("biz_id") or "",
        "异常类型": task.get("anomaly_type") or "",
        "标题": task.get("title") or "",
        "状态": task.get("status") or "",
        "进度": task.get("progress_note") or "",
        "去重键": task.get("dedupe_key") or "",
    }

"""Outbox / 飞书同步 Worker（Phase0 简易轮询）。"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import logging
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from uuid import uuid4

from sqlalchemy import text

from app.adapters.feishu import bitable
from app.config import get_settings
from app.infra.db import SessionLocal

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("qingquan.worker")


async def process_feishu_task_sync(task_id: str) -> None:
    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.feishu_bitable_app_token or not settings.feishu_bitable_table_tasks:
        logger.warning("feishu table not configured, skip task %s", task_id)
        return

    token = await bitable.get_tenant_access_token()
    if not token:
        logger.warning("feishu credentials missing, skip")
        return

    async with SessionLocal() as db:
        row = (
            await db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                    SELECT id::text, dedupe_key, status, platform, shop_id::text, anomaly_type,
                           biz_id, title, owner_user_id::text, due_at, progress_note,
                           created_at, updated_at, resolved_at
                    FROM task WHERE id = :id
                    """
                ),
                {"id": task_id},
            )
        ).mappings().first()
        if not row:
            return
        task = dict(row)
        fields = bitable.task_to_fields(task)
        chash = bitable.content_hash(fields)

        mapped = (
            await db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                    SELECT id::text, record_id, content_hash
                    FROM sync_feishu_map
                    WHERE table_key = 'tasks' AND local_id = :lid
                    """
                ),
                {"lid": task_id},
            )
        ).mappings().first()

        app_token = settings.feishu_bitable_app_token
        table_id = settings.feishu_bitable_table_tasks

        if mapped and mapped["content_hash"] == chash:
            logger.info("task %s unchanged, skip feishu", task_id)
            return

        if mapped:
            await bitable.batch_update_records(
                token, app_token, table_id, [(mapped["record_id"], fields)]
            )
            await db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                    UPDATE sync_feishu_map
                    SET content_hash = :h, synced_at = now()
                    WHERE id = :id
                    """
                ),
                {"h": chash, "id": mapped["id"]},
            )
            logger.info("updated feishu record for task %s", task_id)
        else:
            ids = await bitable.batch_create_records(token, app_token, table_id, [fields])
            if not ids:
                raise RuntimeError("batch_create returned empty")
            await db.execute(
                text(
                    """
                    INSERT INTO sync_feishu_map (
                        id, table_key, local_table, local_id, app_token, table_id,
                        record_id, content_hash, synced_at
                    ) VALUES (
                        :id, 'tasks', 'task', :local_id, :app_token, :table_id,
                        :record_id, :h, now()
                    )
                    """
                ),
                {
                    "id": str(uuid4()),
                    "local_id": task_id,
                    "app_token": app_token,
                    "table_id": table_id,
                    "record_id": ids[0],
                    "h": chash,
                },
            )
            logger.info("created feishu record for task %s", task_id)
        await db.commit()


async def drain_outbox_once() -> int:

async def process_feishu_task_sync(task_id: str) -> None:
    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.feishu_bitable_app_token or not settings.feishu_bitable_table_tasks:
        logger.warning("feishu table not configured, skip task %s", task_id)

                           created_at, updated_at, resolved_at

                ),
                {"id": task_id},
            )
        ).mappings().first()

            return
        task = dict(row)
        fields = bitable.task_to_fields(task)

            await db.execute(

                    )

                    "local_id": task_id,
                    "app_token": app_token,
                    "table_id": table_id,
                    "record_id": ids[0],

# 清泉跨境系统（企业级）

多平台（Amazon / TikTok / Temu）运营数据汇总与任务闭环的企业私有化平台。

数据以 **PostgreSQL 为 Source of Truth**，飞书多维表为同步出口；采集端复用现有海外仓 / Temu / TK 三套工具，经统一 Ingest API 上报。

## 文档

| 文档 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| [docs/架构方案.md](docs/架构方案.md) | 总体架构、分期、部署 |
| [docs/会议纪要-技术会.md](docs/会议纪要-技术会.md) | 技术会需求摘要 |
| [docs/字段映射字典.md](docs/字段映射字典.md) | 采集 ↔ 中心表 ↔ 飞书字段 |
| [docs/Phase0-实施计划.md](docs/Phase0-实施计划.md) | 2–3 周基座计划 |
| [docs/TK中心化改造方案.md](docs/TK中心化改造方案.md) | TK 广告先上报中心再写飞书 |
| [docs/openapi-v1.yaml](docs/openapi-v1.yaml) | Phase0 OpenAPI |

## 目录

```
backend/          FastAPI 中心服务
deploy/           docker-compose
collectors/       边缘采集与 Agent SDK
docs/             方案与字典
packages/         共享库（预留）
web/              管理端（Phase0 后补）
```

## 快速启动（Phase0 骨架）

### 前置

- Docker Desktop / Docker Engine
- （可选）本机 Python 3.12：跑 seed 与 mock

### 启动

```powershell
cd "E:\project\清泉跨境系统（企业级）"
copy .env.example .env
cd deploy
docker compose up -d --build
```

首次数据库会自动执行 `backend/migrations/001_init.sql`。

### 种子数据

```powershell
docker compose exec api python -m app.scripts.seed
```

默认管理员：`admin` / `admin123`（登录后请修改）。

### 验证

```powershell
curl http://localhost:8000/health

# 登录
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/login `
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" `
  -d "{\"username\":\"admin\",\"password\":\"admin123\"}"

# 模拟 TK 广告上报（本机 Python）
$env:QINGQUAN_URL="http://127.0.0.1:8000"
$env:QINGQUAN_API_KEY="dev-ingest-key"
python ..\collectors\agent-core\mock_ingest_tiktok.py
```

API 文档：http://localhost:8000/docs

### Worker（飞书同步）

在 `.env` 填入飞书应用与任务表后：

```powershell
docker compose --profile worker up -d worker
```

飞书多维表需包含列（可调 `task_to_fields` 映射）：平台、业务ID、异常类型、标题、状态、进度、去重键。

## 与现有项目关系

| 项目 | 路径 | 策略 |
|------|------|------|
| 海外仓 | `E:\project\海外仓` | 发货桥暂独立；赛狐客户端后续抽到 sellfox-worker |
| Temu | `E:\project\temu` | Phase1 增加中心上报 |
| TK 广告 | `E:\project\海外TK店铺广告投流数据自动化监测` | 按 [TK中心化改造方案](docs/TK中心化改造方案.md) 旁路 dual 写入 |

## Phase0 已具备

- [x] 架构与字段/改造文档
- [x] PG 表结构（用户/店铺/ingest/广告事实/任务/飞书映射/outbox）
- [x] FastAPI：登录、店铺、Ingest、任务状态机、心跳、导出入队
- [x] 任务去重（部分唯一索引 + 引擎）
- [x] 飞书 Bitable 适配器 + Worker 轮询 outbox
- [x] Agent SDK + TK mock 幂等脚本
- [x] Docker Compose

## 下一步

1. 按 Phase0 计划补 Vue 任务台  
2. TK 项目接入 `qingquan` dual 模式  
3. Temu 下架/限流 → 任务  
4. 亚马逊销售异常 Job + 前台巡检插件  

## 安全提示

content.text:
简单说：**不替换你现在的 TK 抓取和写飞书流程，只在中间多插一步「顺便上报到清泉中心」**。这就是 Stage A 旁路补丁。

---

## 现在 TK 怎么跑

```
每天 17:20
  紫鸟开店 → 抓广告数据 → 直接写入飞书多维表 → 生成日报
```

飞书是数据落点；清泉中心库里还没有这些广告数据。

---

## Stage A 改成什么样

```
每天 17:20
  紫鸟开店 → 抓广告数据
       ├─【新增旁路】POST 到清泉中心 /api/v1/ingest/tiktok_ads
       └─【原逻辑保留】继续直接写飞书
  → 生成日报（不变）
```

- **旁路** = 在旁边加一条路，不是换主路  
- **补丁** = 只改少量脚本/配置，不大重构  

---

## 为什么叫「旁路」、为什么安全

| 点 | 说明 |
|----|------|
| 飞书照旧写 | 运营看的表、现有习惯不变 |
| 中心挂了也不影响 | `failOpen=true`：上报失败只打日志，**不阻断**写飞书 |
| 计划任务不用改 | 还是 17:20 那个任务 |
| 抓取逻辑不用改 | 紫鸟开店、`scrape-ads-page.js` 都不动 |
| 可随时关掉 | 配置里 `qingquan.enabled=false` 就回到现在 |

所以 Stage A 的目标是：**先让中心库里开始有真实 TK 广告数据**，同时生产零风险。

---

## 具体会动 TK 项目里哪些东西

项目路径：`E:\project\海外TK店铺广告投流数据自动化监测`

1. **`config/stores.config.json`**  
   增加一段：
   ```json
   "qingquan": {
     "enabled": true,
     "baseUrl": "http://中心地址:8000",
     "apiKey": "dev-ingest-key",
     "failOpen": true
   },
   "feishu": {
     "writeMode": "dual"
   }
   ```

2. **新建 `scripts/qingquan-client.ps1`**  
   封装调用清泉 Ingest API 的函数。

3. **改 `scripts/run-multi-store.ps1`**  
   在「抓成功 → 写飞书」之间加：组装数据 → 调 `Send-QingquanIngest` → 再按原逻辑写飞书。

4. **（可选）改 Chrome 扩展**  
   Popup 手动抓取时也先上报中心；Stage A 可以先只做计划任务那条主路径。

---

## 和后面 Stage 的关系

| 阶段 | 行为 |
|------|------|
| **现在** | 只写飞书 |
| **Stage A（旁路）** | 中心 + 飞书都写（双写） |
| **Stage B** | 只上报中心，飞书改由中心同步（解决重复行、以库为准） |
| **Stage C** | 日报也改读中心，低 ROI 自动建任务等 |

你之前选的「先 TK 上云」，第一步就是 Stage A：  
**先双写验证数据对不对，再考虑让中心当唯一数据源。**

---

## 一句话

> **Stage A 旁路补丁** = 在 TK 现有「抓完写飞书」流程上，加一句「同时送给清泉中心」；中心挂了也不影响飞书，用来安全试跑上云。

如果你愿意做，我可以直接改 TK 项目里的配置和 `run-multi-store.ps1`；需要你先把清泉中心起起来（或告诉我中心 API 地址）。

content.text:
这是上一轮结束时我建议的**第一步自检**，意思是：

> 用 Docker 把清泉中心起起来，确认接口活着，再用模拟数据验证「同一条上报两次不会变成两条」。

拆开说：

---

## 1. 「起 Compose」是什么

`docker compose` 是一键拉起整套服务的工具。  
项目里已经写好了：

`E:\project\清泉跨境系统（企业级）\deploy\docker-compose.yml`

执行后大约会起：

| 容器 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| **api** | 清泉后端（FastAPI，端口 8000） |
| **db** | PostgreSQL 数据库 |
| **redis** | 缓存/队列 |

也就是：**不用你本机先装 Python/Postgres，用 Docker 把中心环境跑起来。**

---

## 2. 「跑通 health」是什么

中心有一个健康检查接口：

```http
GET http://localhost:8000/health
```

正常应返回类似：

```json
{"status":"ok","time":"..."}
```

含义：

- 容器起来了  
- API 进程在听端口  
- 最基本的 HTTP 通路是通的  

**health 通了 = 环境没挂在启动阶段。**

---

## 3. 「mock 幂等」是什么

**mock** = 假数据试跑，不连紫鸟、不抓真广告。  
脚本是：

`collectors/agent-core/mock_ingest_tiktok.py`

它会模拟一条 TK 广告（例如「拖把7/13」）调用：

```http
POST /api/v1/ingest/tiktok_ads
```

**幂等** = 同样的业务键交多次，结果应一样，不能多插脏数据。

脚本会：

1. **第一次**上报 → 期望 `accepted: 1`（新建成功）  
2. **第二次**用同一个 `idempotency_key` 再报 → 期望 `duplicated: 1`（识别为重复，不新建）

两边都符合，就打印 `OK: idempotency verified`。

含义：

- Ingest API 通了  
- 数据库写入通了  
- 去重/幂等键生效了（后面 TK 真实双写、同日重跑才不会炸库）

---

## 4. 合在一起在验证什么

```
Docker 起中心
    → health 通了吗？     （服务活着）
    → mock 上报通了吗？   （采集入口可用）
    → 第二次算重复吗？   （幂等可靠）
```

全部通过 = **Phase0 中心骨架在你这台机器上可用**，后面才适合去改 TK 做旁路上报。

还没验证就改 TK：中心若起不来，旁路要么一直失败，要么你以为上云了其实库是空的。

---

## 5. 和你要做的操作对应关系

| 步骤 | 命令意图 |
|------|----------|
| 起 Compose | `docker compose up -d --build` |
| 初始化管理员/店铺 | `python -m app.scripts.seed` |
| 跑通 health | 浏览器或 curl 访问 `/health` |
| mock 幂等 | 跑 `mock_ingest_tiktok.py`，看两次结果 |

---

## 一句话

> **起 Compose 跑通 health + mock 幂等** = 先在本机用 Docker 把清泉中心拉起来，确认「服务活着 + 模拟上报成功 + 重复上报不会重复入库」，把环境验合格，再去接真 TK 数据。

如果你愿意，我可以下一步直接在你这台机器上执行这套启动和验证（需要本机已装 Docker）。

if (-not (Test-Path "$data\PG_VERSION")) {
  Write-Host "initdb $data ..."
  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $data | Out-Null
  # Windows 上 initdb 常用当前用户；设置信任本地连接方便开发
  & "$bin\initdb.exe" -D $data -U postgres -A trust -E UTF8 --locale=C 2>&1
  if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "initdb failed: $LASTEXITCODE" }

BEFORE invoking, check if the question is specific enough to research directly — if underspecified (e.g., "what car to buy" without budget/use-case/region), ask 2-3 clarifying questions to narrow scope. Then pass the refined question as args, weaving the answers in.
- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.

- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).

- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). $root = "E:\project\清泉跨境系统（企业级）"
$py = "$root\backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe"
$backend = "$root\backend"

# 环境变量
$env:DATABASE_URL = "postgresql+asyncpg://qingquan:qingquan@127.0.0.1:5432/qingquan"
$env:APP_SECRET_KEY = "dev-secret-change-me"
$env:INGEST_DEFAULT_API_KEY = "dev-ingest-key"
$env:ADMIN_USERNAME = "admin"
$env:ADMIN_PASSWORD = "admin123"
$env:APP_ENV = "dev"
$env:REDIS_URL = "redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0"
$env:PYTHONPATH = $backend

# 停掉可能占用 8000 的旧进程
Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object {
  try { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}
}

# seed
Set-Location $backend
Write-Host "=== SEED ==="
& $py -m app.scripts.seed 2>&1

# 后台启动 API
Write-Host "=== START API ==="
$apiLog = "$root\logs\api.log"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "$root\logs" | Out-Null
$api = Start-Process -FilePath $py -ArgumentList @('-m','uvicorn','app.main:app','--host','127.0.0.1','--port','8000') -WorkingDirectory $backend -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput $apiLog -RedirectStandardError "$root\logs\api.err.log" -WindowStyle Hidden
Write-Host "API PID=$($api.Id)"

$ready = $false
for ($i = 0; $i -lt 40; $i++) {
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
  try {
    $h = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/health' -TimeoutSec 2
    if ($h.status -eq 'ok') { $ready = $true; Write-Host "health OK: $($h | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)"; break }
  } catch {}
}
if (-not $ready) {
  Write-Host "API failed to start. err log:"
  Get-Content "$root\logs\api.err.log" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Last 40
  Get-Content $apiLog -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Last 40
  exit 1
}

# mock 幂等
Write-Host "=== MOCK IDEMPOTENCY ==="
$env:QINGQUAN_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
$env:QINGQUAN_API_KEY = "dev-ingest-key"
& $py "$root\collectors\agent-core\mock_ingest_tiktok.py" 2>&1

# 登录 + 建任务 smoke

$token = $login.access_token
Write-Host "token len=$($token.Length)"
$headers = @{ Authorization = "Bearer $token" }
$shops = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/shops' -Headers $headers
Write-Host "shops=$($shops.items.Count)"
$task1 = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/tasks' -Headers $headers -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"platform":"tiktok","anomaly_type":"low_roi","biz_id":"拖把7/13","title":"低ROI演示任务","progress_note":"首次检出"}'
Write-Host "task1 id=$($task1.id) status=$($task1.status)"
$task2 = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/tasks' -Headers $headers -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"platform":"tiktok","anomaly_type":"low_roi","biz_id":"拖把7/13","title":"低ROI演示任务","progress_note":"再次上报应合并"}'
Write-Host "task2 id=$($task2.id) same=$($task1.id -eq $task2.id) note=$($task2.progress_note)"

Write-Host "API_PID=$($api.Id)"

input.command:
$bin = "C:\PostgreSQL\16\bin"
$data = "C:\qingquan-pgdata"

# 启动服务
Start-Service postgresql-qq-16 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
$svc = Get-Service postgresql-qq-16
Write-Host "service=$($svc.Status)"

if ($svc.Status -ne 'Running') {
  Write-Host "trying pg_ctl..."
  & "$bin\pg_ctl.exe" -D $data -l "$data\pg.log" start 2>&1
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
}

# 用 trust 或 postgres 密码连
$env:PGPASSWORD = "postgres"
& "$bin\psql.exe" -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT version();" 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 5

# 确保角色密码正确 + 库存在
& "$bin\psql.exe" -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c @"
DO `$`$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'qingquan') THEN
    CREATE ROLE qingquan LOGIN PASSWORD 'qingquan';
  ELSE
    ALTER ROLE qingquan WITH LOGIN PASSWORD 'qingquan';
  END IF;
END
`$`$;
SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='qingquan';
"@ 2>&1

$exists = & "$bin\psql.exe" -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='qingquan'"
if ("$exists".Trim() -ne '1') {
  & "$bin\psql.exe" -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE qingquan OWNER qingquan;"
}
& "$bin\psql.exe" -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d postgres -c "GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON DATABASE qingquan TO qingquan;"
& "$bin\psql.exe" -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d qingquan -c "GRANT ALL ON SCHEMA public TO qingquan; ALTER SCHEMA public OWNER TO qingquan;"

# 重新执行迁移（IF NOT EXISTS）
& "$bin\psql.exe" -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d qingquan -f "E:\project\清泉跨境系统（企业级）\backend\migrations\001_init.sql" 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 15

$env:PGPASSWORD = "qingquan"
& "$bin\psql.exe" -h 127.0.0.1 -U qingquan -d qingquan -c "SELECT COUNT(*) AS tables FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public';" 2>&1

# 清泉跨境系统（企业级）

多平台（Amazon / TikTok / Temu）运营数据汇总与任务闭环的企业私有化平台。

数据以 **PostgreSQL 为 Source of Truth**，飞书多维表为同步出口；采集端复用现有海外仓 / Temu / TK 三套工具，经统一 Ingest API 上报。

## 文档

| 文档 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| [docs/架构方案.md](docs/架构方案.md) | 总体架构、分期、部署 |
| [docs/会议纪要-技术会.md](docs/会议纪要-技术会.md) | 技术会需求摘要 |
| [docs/字段映射字典.md](docs/字段映射字典.md) | 采集 ↔ 中心表 ↔ 飞书字段 |
| [docs/Phase0-实施计划.md](docs/Phase0-实施计划.md) | 2–3 周基座计划 |
| [docs/TK中心化改造方案.md](docs/TK中心化改造方案.md) | TK 广告先上报中心再写飞书 |
| [docs/openapi-v1.yaml](docs/openapi-v1.yaml) | Phase0 OpenAPI |

## 目录

```
backend/          FastAPI 中心服务
deploy/           docker-compose
collectors/       边缘采集与 Agent SDK
docs/             方案与字典
packages/         共享库（预留）
web/              管理端（Phase0 后补）
```

## 快速启动（Phase0 骨架）

### 前置

- Docker Desktop / Docker Engine
- （可选）本机 Python 3.12：跑 seed 与 mock

### 启动

```powershell
cd "E:\project\清泉跨境系统（企业级）"
copy .env.example .env
cd deploy
docker compose up -d --build
```

首次数据库会自动执行 `backend/migrations/001_init.sql`。

### 种子数据

```powershell
docker compose exec api python -m app.scripts.seed
```

默认管理员：`admin` / `admin123`（登录后请修改）。

### 验证

```powershell
curl http://localhost:8000/health

# 登录
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/v1/auth/login `
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" `
  -d "{\"username\":\"admin\",\"password\":\"admin123\"}"

# 模拟 TK 广告上报（本机 Python）

$env:QINGQUAN_API_KEY="dev-ingest-key"
python ..\collectors\agent-core\mock_ingest_tiktok.py
```

API 文档：http://localhost:8000/docs

### Worker（飞书同步）


## 与现有项目关系

| 项目 | 路径 | 策略 |
|------|------|------|
| 海外仓 | `E:\project\海外仓` | 发货桥暂独立；赛狐客户端后续抽到 sellfox-worker |
| Temu | `E:\project\temu` | Phase1 增加中心上报 |
| TK 广告 | `E:\project\海外TK店铺广告投流数据自动化监测` | 按 [TK中心化改造方案](docs/TK中心化改造方案.md) 旁路 dual 写入 |

## Phase0 已具备

- [x] 架构与字段/改造文档
- [x] PG 表结构（用户/店铺/ingest/广告事实/任务/飞书映射/outbox）
- [x] FastAPI：登录、店铺、Ingest、任务状态机、心跳、导出入队
- [x] 任务去重（部分唯一索引 + 引擎）
- [x] 飞书 Bitable 适配器 + Worker 轮询 outbox
- [x] Agent SDK + TK mock 幂等脚本
- [x] Docker Compose

## 下一步

1. 按 Phase0 计划补 Vue 任务台  
2. TK 项目接入 `qingquan` dual 模式  
3. Temu 下架/限流 → 任务  
4. 亚马逊销售异常 Job + 前台巡检插件

content.text:
因为**安装过程中试了两次、装到了两个不同目录**，不是业务上故意要双开。

## 时间线（就是上次环境排查时发生的）

### 1. 第一次：`winget install PostgreSQL.PostgreSQL.16`

- 目标默认路径一般是：  
  `C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16`
- 当时装得**不完整**（`lib` 几乎是空的，缺 `dict_snowball.dll`，`initdb` 失败）
- `winget` 那次任务最后也失败了（exit 255）
- 但磁盘上已经留下了 **Program Files 下的半成品/后续又被补全的痕迹**

### 2. 第二次：手动下安装包 + 静默安装

因为第一次不可用，我又：

1. `winget download` 拉了完整安装包  
2. 用 EDB 静默参数重装  

为了**躲开 `Program Files` 路径空格**导致的参数解析错误，第二次显式指定了：

| 项 | 路径 |
|----|------|
| 程序目录 | `C:\PostgreSQL\16` |
| 数据目录 | `C:\qingquan-pgdata` |
| 服务名 | `postgresql-qq-16` |

这次 `exit=0`，`lib` 正常，服务也曾 `Running`。

### 3. 为什么现在像“两套都在”

后来出现过：

- `postgresql-qq-16`（`C:\qingquan-pgdata`）**起不来**  
- 日志提示：**5432 已被占用**
- 查端口发现监听进程是：  
  `C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16\bin\postgres.exe`

也就是说：

- **真正在跑、我们后来连上并建库的**，是 **Program Files 那套**（可能是 winget 后续补全了，或系统里又有一份能跑的实例）
- **`C:\PostgreSQL\16` + `C:\qingquan-pgdata`** 是第二次静默装出来的另一套，服务多半已停，但文件还在

所以不是“公司要两套库”，而是：

> **装挂了 → 换路径再装一次 → 旧目录没清干净 → 端口被其中一套占住**

---

## 现在各自是什么状态（概念上）

```
C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\16     ← 当前占 5432、实际在用的那套
C:\PostgreSQL\16                   ← 第二次静默安装的程序文件
C:\qingquan-pgdata                 ← 第二次的数据目录（多半没在听端口）
服务名 postgresql-qq-16            ← 对应第二套，可能 Stopped
```

业务库 `qingquan`、表、seed、mock 数据，都在**正在听 5432 的那套**里。

---

## 建议怎么处理（可选）

长期只留一套即可，例如：

1. 确认只有一个 `postgres` 在听 5432（Task Manager / `Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5432`）
2. **保留在用的那套**（现在是 Program Files）
3. 不用的那套：
   - 停服务、卸载，或至少删掉不用的目录  
   - 避免以后再 `Start-Service` 时抢端口、连错实例

如果你要，我可以下一步直接帮你在本机查清「谁在听 5432、两套分别能不能连」，并给出一份**只保留一套的清理步骤**（先备份再动）。
